leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement CSS Modules by creating and importing a dedicated stylesheet for a React component
Apply scoped CSS classes to JSX elements using the imported styles object
Construct a component with multiple styled elements using CSS Modules for encapsulation
Configure a React project to support CSS Modules by verifying the build system setup
Update existing inline styles or global CSS to use CSS Modules for better maintainability
Manipulate dynamic styling by conditionally applying CSS Modules classes based on component state or props
Integrate CSS Modules with component composition by passing class names as props to child components
